generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Build unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, validators, fixtures, checklists, and verification scripts.

contract.purpose_user_function: Construct unit, integration, end-to-end tests, validators, fixtures, and verification scripts.
contract.valid_inputs: Feature contract/acceptance criteria, implementation surface, runner/platform, fixtures/mocks, failure cases, and evidence requirements.
contract.expected_outputs: Executable test files/fixtures/validators with stable assertions and documented prerequisites.
contract.state_side_effects: Creates test/fixture files; running them writes normal test artifacts/caches in isolated locations.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing observable contract, unavailable runner/platform, unsafe live dependency, flaky oracle, or scope conflict blocks verified delivery.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Repository has multiple test suites/runners and skills/test; automated authoring is delegated to builders.
contract.success_evidence: Tests collect/run on declared runner, fail against broken behavior, pass against current behavior, and emit reproducible evidence.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: positive; negative; boundary; idempotence; platform/provider mocked/live-opt-in; flaky isolation.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow and Appendix AutoSci Commands; docs/WORKFLOW_DESIGN.md Phases 2-5; AGENTS.md Scope and Local Workflow
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Solar ships primarily as a Claude Code overlay. Concrete builds depend on selected physical operators, language toolchains, credentials, datasets, hardware, and approval/write-scope policy.

implementation.interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
